summary:
Leaderboards: total level, net worth, guilds, and one board for each of the GDD's sixteen skills (GDD section 6). There is no story board.

Server: a new module, `src/leaderboards.ts`, ranks Tinkers and guilds from the existing tables (skills, purses, inventory, open orders, guild members). No migration.
- **Route:** `GET /tinkers/:id/leaderboards/:board`, added to `api.ts` beside the Ledger pages route. It goes through the same sign-in and ownership check, so the caller's own row can be marked.
- **Response:** the top 100 rows, plus the caller's own row even when it falls outside them.
- **Ranks:** equal scores share a rank (1, 1, 3).
- **Bans:** a fully banned account's Tinkers never appear on any board and don't count toward a guild's total. A chat ban hides nothing.
- **Errors:** an unknown board gives 400; an unknown Tinker gives 404.

Tests: `test/leaderboards.test.ts` runs through the API against the real database. It covers:
- the total-level order and your own row
- the shared rank on a skill tie, and skill boards leaving out Tinkers with no XP in that skill
- net worth: Crowns, Crowns held in open buy orders, unbound goods at the collectors' price, bound goods counting nothing
- guilds ranked by their members' total levels, with guilds still forming left out
- a full ban hiding a Tinker everywhere while a chat ban hides nothing
- the 400 and 404 cases

Client:
- **Screen:** `src/Leaderboards.tsx` has board tabs, a short note on how each board counts, the ranked list with your row in brass, and your own rank below the list when you are outside the top 100.
- **Fetcher:** `api.leaderboard` in `src/api.ts`.
- **Navigation:** a "Leaderboards" row in the side list (`SideNav`) and a "Ranks" button on the phone's bottom bar (`BottomBar`).
- **How it opens (check this first):** I couldn't see `Workshop.tsx`, so the screen opens as an overlay over the workshop. `App.tsx` wraps the workshop in a small provider instead of the screen being a `Place`. To make it a normal place, add a `leaderboards` entry to `Place` and a case in `Workshop.tsx`.

Nothing has been run yet: the typecheck, tests and validation are still to do.
open_questions: Net worth: Crowns in the purse, plus Crowns held in open buy orders, plus unbound goods (held or in open sell orders) at the collectors' price. Goods the collectors don't buy, and bound goods, count as nothing. Gilded Cogs are left out because they are bought with money and the GDD says nothing is exclusive to paying players. Exchange fills not yet collected and pledges to an open charter are not counted.
Guild board: only formed (active) guilds, ranked by their members' total levels added together, showing the member count. Charters still raising the fee are not shown.

Ties: equal scores share a rank (1, 1, 3). On the total board, a tie in total level goes to the Tinker with more total XP. Skill boards rank by XP and show the level. Any remaining tie is listed by name.
A board shows the top 100 (BOARD_SIZE), plus the caller's own row when it is lower.
Skill boards list only Tinkers with some XP in that skill. The total and net worth boards list every Tinker.
Boards are per Tinker, not per account, so all three of an account's Tinkers can appear.
Boards read the stored projections and do not resolve other Tinkers' offline Boilers, so each Tinker counts as of its last visit. The screen says so.
Fully banned accounts are left out of every board and out of guild totals. A guild whose members are all fully banned is not shown. Chat bans don't affect the boards.
The GDD puts leaderboards in ElastiCache for Valkey. This build reads them from PostgreSQL to add no dependency. Moving them to Valkey later only changes the server module.

The screen opens as an overlay over the workshop, from a row in the side list and a 'Ranks' button on the phone's bottom bar. It is not a Place, because I could not see Workshop.tsx's place switch to wire one in. It shows from the start, not revealed by the first-session guide, since the GDD says any player can open the boards.
